sources.title: Deposit checks with Chase QuickDeposit
sources.claim: QuickDeposit flow: choose account, enter amount, photograph endorsed check, submit; email when received and accepted; deposits before 11 PM ET on a business day generally available next business day.
caveats: Page states no deposit limits or eligibility rules
Chase may delay availability pending review
sources.local_note: Endorse 'For electronic deposit only at Chase'; before 11 PM ET business day generally available next business day; keep check two business days or until accepted, then destroy.

sources.title: Send and receive money fast with Zelle
sources.claim: Send/receive by email or US mobile, request money, split from card/checking activity, QR codes; dynamic daily send limits; no Chase consumer fee; no purchase protection.
caveats: Exact limits not disclosed
Mentions 2,000+ banking apps while S07 says more than 2,200
Business Zelle tags mentioned are business-only
sources.local_note: Dynamic daily send limits based on factors including recipient; Chase does not charge consumers additional fees; minutes to Chase customers, 1-3 business days otherwise; cannot be reversed once recipient enrolls.

sources.title: Send & Receive Money FAQs
sources.claim: Zelle funds typically available in minutes when recipient enrolled; select transactions up to 3 business days; enrollment with eligible US checking or savings account required.
caveats: No personal limit figures on page
sources.local_note: Funds typically available in minutes when recipient email or US mobile already enrolled; select transactions could take up to 3 business days; enrollment requires eligible US checking or savings account.

sources.title: Chase Pay Over Time After Purchase FAQs
sources.page_scope: Pay Over Time (formerly My Chase Plan) FAQ
sources.claim: Eligible purchases $100+; typically up to 10 active or pending plans; 3-24 months with 1-3 duration options; fixed monthly fee instead of interest; plan cannot be changed or cancelled but can be paid early; plan payment added to minimum due.
caveats: Availability based on current account information
Max fee 1.72% figure appears on S07 and search snippet, not confirmed on FAQ fetch
Pay Over Time at checkout referenced but not detailed
sources.local_note: Purchases $100+ labeled eligible; most customers up to 10 active or pending plans; excludes >90 days old, >$99,999, promo or disputed; 3-24 months, 1-3 options; no change/cancel after creation; returns require a call to apply credit.

sources.title: Frequently asked questions about Chase Offers
sources.claim: Offers linked to one account, must be added before purchase, statement credit within 30 days of posting, not counted as a payment; expired offers cannot be reinstated; no limit on number added.
caveats: Offers personalized; joint cardholders may see different offers
Return/clawback rules not addressed
sources.local_note: Each Chase Offer linked to only one account; statement credits appear within 30 days after qualifying transactions post; credit not counted as a payment; cannot reinstate an expired offer; no limit to offers you can add.

sources.title: Check Your Credit Score for Free with Credit Journey
sources.claim: VantageScore 3.0 by Experian, no Chase account required, credit report access, score-change explanation, dark-web/breach identity monitoring alerts.
caveats: Lenders including Chase may not use VantageScore 3.0
Enrollment prerequisites (age, SSN) not stated
sources.local_note: Credit Journey uses VantageScore 3.0 by Experian; no Chase account required; lenders (including Chase) may not use VantageScore 3.0.

sources.title: Spending Budget
sources.claim: Auto-categorized spending to merchant level, category budgets, over-budget message, monthly/quarterly/annual views; includes Chase/JPM checking, credit cards and linked external accounts; desktop export PDF/CSV/QFX/QIF/QBO.
caveats: States access requires a Chase checking account and Chase credit card; CR-CH-08 says checking and credit card customers - and/or ambiguity
Exports desktop only
sources.local_note: Over budget: message in Spending Planner that you have exceeded your budget; includes posted transactions on JPM or Chase checking, credit cards and linked external accounts; transfers excluded.

sources.title: What's the Chase Budget Tool?
sources.claim: Budget built from monthly income, recurring bills, savings target and category spending amounts; 10 budget categories; Spending Planner uses 17 categories.
caveats: Observed only via search result excerpt, page not fetched in full
sources.local_note: Budget tool: income, recurring monthly bills, savings target and per-category discretionary amounts; 10 budget categories vs 17 Spending Planner categories.

sources.title: Start Investing Online Today with J.P. Morgan
sources.page_scope: J.P. Morgan Self-Directed Investing product page
sources.claim: Unlimited $0 online trades on stocks, ETFs, options, mutual funds, money market funds, Treasuries; options $0.65 per contract; fractional shares from $5 on S&P 500/NASDAQ 100; no minimum; ITIN/EIN ineligible; bonus up to $1,000, offer expires 01/21/2027.
caveats: JPMS member FINRA/SIPC; NOT FDIC insured
Bonus offer time-limited
sources.local_note: $0 commission online trades; options $0.65 per contract fee; fractional shares as little as $5 for S&P 500 and NASDAQ 100; no minimum; ITIN or EIN not eligible; bonus up to $1,000, offer expires 01/21/2027.

sources.title: Investment Account Funding FAQs
sources.claim: Transfers from Chase checking before 4:30 PM ET typically available immediately but up to 1 business day; external banks 1-3 business days; no inbound fee; online account transfers for Individual, Roth IRA, Traditional IRA, Beneficiary IRA.
caveats: Other account types require PDF form
sources.local_note: Before 4:30 PM ET typically available immediately but can take up to 1 business day; non-Chase 1-3 business days; online account transfers only for Individual, Roth IRA, Traditional IRA, Beneficiary IRA.

sources.title: Rollover Your 401(k) to J.P. Morgan
sources.claim: Open JPM Self-Directed IRA/Roth IRA, contact plan administrator, check payable to J.P. Morgan FBO name; can deposit via QuickDeposit; no JPM rollover fee.
caveats: Observed via search excerpt; tax guidance is general
sources.local_note: Open Self-Directed IRA or Roth IRA, have plan administrator issue check payable to J.P. Morgan FBO you; deposit via QuickDeposit or branch; J.P. Morgan doesn't charge fees for rollovers.

sources.title: A Quick Guide to Locking Your Credit Card
sources.claim: Lock helps prevent new charges and cash advances while recurring payments continue; fees, interest and points accrual frequently still permitted.
caveats: Digital-wallet, refund and balance-transfer behavior not addressed
A search excerpt claimed wallet purchases still work while locked; not confirmed on fetched page
sources.local_note: Lock helps prevent new charges and cash advances, allowing recurring payments to continue; other charges like fees, interest, points accrual frequently still permitted.

sources.title: Chase Debit/ATM Card FAQs
sources.claim: In app: Manage account > Lock & unlock card; Replace a lost or damaged card; activation online, by phone or ATM.
caveats: No PIN, limits, travel-notice details on page
sources.local_note: Manage account section: 'Lock & unlock card' and 'Replace a lost or damaged card'; activate online, by phone (1-800-290-3935) or at Chase ATMs.

sources.title: Account Alerts
sources.claim: Email/text/push alerts for transactions, balance, payment due/posted; fraud alerts automatic without enrollment; security alerts instant; daily alerts processed end of business day.
caveats: Observed via search excerpt
Delivery may be delayed by outages
sources.local_note: Fraud alerts sent automatically without enrollment; alerts by email, text, push; security alerts instant; daily alerts processed end of business day Mon-Fri, delivered Tue-Sat.

sources.title: Unauthorized Transactions FAQs
sources.claim: Zero Liability reimbursement for unauthorized debit card transactions when reported promptly; certain limitations apply per Deposit Account Agreement.
caveats: No deadlines, provisional credit or Zelle-scam terms on page
sources.local_note: Chase will reimburse unauthorized debit card transactions when reported promptly. Certain limitations apply.

sources.title: Report a Problem with a Transaction
sources.claim: Tap transaction > Report a problem > select scenario > dispute form; dispute tracker lists open and closed disputes.
caveats: Observed via search excerpt; URL is desktop help path
sources.local_note: Click the charge, Report a problem, select scenario, Next; dispute tracking tool lists open and closed disputes with View details.

sources.title: Online Bill Pay
sources.claim: Pay bills > Schedule payment; add/manage payees; Send on or Deliver by date; eBills for eligible payees; no fees.
caveats: Observed via search excerpt
sources.local_note: Pay bills > Schedule payment; choose payee, amount, Pay from, Send on or Deliver by date; eBills for eligible payees; no fees.

sources.title: How to transfer money between accounts within Chase / ACH Transfer
sources.claim: One-time or repeating transfers between Chase accounts; external accounts by routing/account; dynamic external limits shown at setup; 2-3 business days; wires $25 domestic online, $40 international USD via app.
caveats: Observed via search excerpts across chase.com/digital/transfer and fee docs; wire fees must be rechecked against Additional Banking Services and Fees PDF
sources.local_note: Repeating or one-time transfers between Chase accounts; external limit dynamically determined and displayed at setup; non-Chase 2-3 business days; online domestic wire $25, international USD $40.

sources.title: Chase Ultimate Rewards in the Chase Mobile app
sources.claim: Rewards balance on Accounts page with pending points; redeem cash back ($0.01/pt), travel (Sapphire Preferred $0.0125, Reserve $0.015), gift cards, Pay Yourself Back, Pay with Points, partner transfers; Shop through Chase 1-15 bonus points/$.
caveats: Undated; travel values conflict with CR-CH-20 Points Boost guide (standard $0.01)
sources.local_note: Cash back typically $0.01 per point; Sapphire Preferred $0.0125 and Sapphire Reserve $0.015 per point via Chase Travel portal.

sources.title: How Points Boost Works
sources.claim: Points worth $0.01 each through Chase Travel; Points Boost up to 2x (Reserve) or 1.5x (Preferred) on select hotels/flights.
caveats: No grandfathering detail for earlier fixed rates
sources.local_note: Sapphire Reserve points worth up to 2x on The Edit hotels and top-booked hotels/flights; Preferred up to 1.5x; standard $0.01 per point.

sources.title: Paperless Statements
sources.claim: Up to 7 years of statements depending on account type; enroll in app via Profile & Settings > Account Settings > Paperless; paper stops after about a month.
caveats: Account types with shorter retention not identified; another Chase page cited 6 years
sources.local_note: Depending on the account type you can securely access up to 7 years of statements; may take a month or so to stop paper.

sources.title: How you can protect yourself (Security Center)
sources.claim: Passkeys; Face/Touch ID and Android biometrics; app 2-step verification using device passcode; chase.com one-time code; trusted device; Chase never asks for codes; Zelle not for retail purchases.
sources.local_note: Passkeys use face, fingerprint or device passcode; app 2-step uses phone passcode or screen lock code; chase.com one-time code option; Chase never asks for codes.

sources.title: Add a card to your digital wallet
sources.claim: Add Chase cards to Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal (and Samsung Pay) from app via Manage account > Digital Wallets; use before physical card arrives; Paze for eligible customers.
caveats: Observed via search excerpts; Paze eligibility tied to recent online card purchase and digital profile
sources.local_note: Manage account > Digital Wallets > choose wallet; add to Apple Pay, Google Pay or Samsung Pay before card arrives; Paze from Early Warning Services.

sources.title: Secure Message Center
sources.claim: Send and receive secure messages with Chase Online Customer Service 24/7 after signing in to chase.com.
caveats: Describes web; app messaging claimed on S07
sources.local_note: Secure Message Center: send and receive secure messages to and from Chase Online Customer Service 24/7; phone 1-800-935-9935.

sources.title: What's Chase Autosave?
sources.claim: Repeat transfers checking to savings on a schedule or on qualifying deposits (amount or %); one deposit-triggered rule per checking account; deposit rules pausable; schedule rules retry 3 business days if insufficient.
caveats: Observed via search excerpt
sources.local_note: Schedule-based or per-deposit (fixed or percentage); only one deposit-triggered repeat transfer per checking account; scheduled transfers cannot be paused; skip/retry rules on insufficient funds.

sources.title: Spend Instantly
sources.claim: Use a new card right away via Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal and Chase app.
caveats: No eligibility or limit details
sources.local_note: Use your new card right away with Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, PayPal.

sources.title: Zelle Support and FAQs (Business)
sources.claim: Tiered daily send limits Tier 0 $500 to Tier 3 $10,000; payment cancellable only if recipient not yet enrolled.
caveats: BUSINESS page; do not apply tier figures to personal accounts
Observed via search excerpt
sources.local_note: Tier 0 $500/day, Tier 1 $2,000, Tier 2 $5,000, Tier 3 $10,000; cancel only if recipient hasn't enrolled.

sources.title: chase.com/QuickDeposit (search excerpt)
sources.claim: Search excerpt states $1,000 per day and $3,000 per 30 days, and that Regulation CC does not apply to check images.
caveats: Not confirmed on fetched official page CR-CH-01; may be legacy or agreement text; treat as unverified
sources.local_note: Excerpt: as much as $1,000 on any day and $3,000 over any 30-day period.
